mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN s.leg_key IN ('LONG','SHORT') AND s.hedge_round_key IS NOT NULL THEN CONCAT('ROUND:', s.hedge_round_key) ELSE CONCAT('STATE:', s.id) END) FROM quant_strategy_position_state s JOIN quant_strategy_instance i ON i.id=s.instance_id LEFT JOIN quant_position p ON p.id=s.position_id WHERE i.strategy_id=#{strategyId} AND i.credential_id=#{credentialId} AND s.status IN ('OPEN_PENDING','OPEN','EXIT_PENDING','PROTECTION_CLEANUP') AND s.position_qty>0 AND (s.status <> 'OPEN' OR p.quantity > 0 OR p.quantity IS NULL)

SELECT s.instance_id AS instanceId, i.status AS instanceStatus, s.leg_key AS legKey, s.hedge_round_key AS hedgeRoundKey, s.position_id AS positionId, s.status AS positionStatus, s.position_qty AS strategyQty, s.pending_action AS pendingAction, s.pending_order_id AS pendingOrderId, s.pending_client_order_id AS pendingClientOrderId, COALESCE(p.symbol, qs.symbol) AS symbol, COALESCE(p.position_side, s.direction) AS positionSide, p.quantity AS localPositionQty, CASE WHEN s.status = 'OPEN_PENDING' THEN NULL ELSE s.opened_at END AS openedAt FROM quant_strategy_position_state s JOIN quant_strategy_instance i ON i.id=s.instance_id LEFT JOIN quant_position p ON p.id=s.position_id LEFT JOIN quant_strategy_symbol qss ON qss.id=i.strategy_symbol_id LEFT JOIN quant_symbol qs ON qs.id=qss.symbol_id WHERE i.strategy_id=#{strategyId} AND i.credential_id=#{credentialId} AND s.status IN ('OPEN_PENDING','OPEN','EXIT_PENDING','PROTECTION_CLEANUP') AND s.position_qty>0 AND (s.status <> 'OPEN' OR p.quantity > 0 OR p.quantity IS NULL) ORDER BY s.updated_at ASC, s.instance_id ASC
